verdict.rationale: An in-product AI insights feature is a fair question for a billing and analytics SaaS like Polar, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The remote MCP server lets external AI agents look up Polar data, but that analysis happens outside the product. The real-time gross-margin view is conventional analytics, not AI-generated, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
